summary: ArcelorMittal filed a Form 6-K on June 3, 2026, attaching a press release regarding a notification of share transaction by a designated person (director or executive officer) under the EU Market Abuse Regulation. The filing does not relate to any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. It is a routine regulatory disclosure of an insider transaction, not a corporate event meriting special-situations classification.
